title: Advances in Electronics and Digital Technologies for Medical and Healthcare: A Survey
content: The integration of electronics and digital technologies into the medical and healthcare sectors has revolutionized the way healthcare services are delivered and managed. Over the past few decades, there have been significant advancements in various areas such as medical devices, diagnostic tools, health monitoring systems, telemedicine, and electronic health records (EHRs). These innovations have led to improved patient outcomes, increased efficiency in healthcare delivery, and the democratization of medical knowledge and services. A thorough analysis and review of electronic applications in healthcare and medicine is necessary. This literature review aims to provide a comprehensive survey of the recent advances in electronics and digital technologies in the medical and healthcare fields, highlighting key developments, current applications, and future trends. This paper presents recent developments in electronics and digital technologies for medical and healthcare applications. It aims to cover the most important topics in the field, including wearable technologies and sensors, robotic surgery, developments during COVID-19, the Medical Internet of Things (M-IoT), electronic healthcare record systems, social media and websites, and smartphone applications. For each topic, there is a comparison or detailed discussion of different applications or features.
